observations.why: Quinton issues a binding requirement from his position as deployment gate owner, exercising authority of role rather than persuasion.
Quinton justifies the gate by citing concrete prior incidents, arguing from evidence for why the requirement exists.
The summary records a mandatory gate framed as a process requirement, restating positional authority in declarative form.
Extending the gate's scope is an exercise of process authority, defining where the requirement binds.
Assigning ownership names the position-holder who carries the gate's authority, a structural power move.
